H600.et: corresponding to (0639) (only in the pl. as a sing.)
H600.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «0639» (only in the plural as a singular); the face:--face, visage.

H601.def: from «0599»; an unclean bird, perhaps the parrot (from its irascibility):--heron.

H602.def: a primitive root; to shriek:--cry, groan.

H604.def: the same as «0603»; some kind of lizard, probably the gecko (from its wail):--ferret.

H605.def: a primitive root; to be frail, feeble, or (figuratively) melancholy:--desperate(-ly wicked), incurable, sick, woeful.

H606.def: (Aramaic) or renash (Aramaic) {en-ash'}; corresponding to «0582»; a man:--man, + whosoever.

H607.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «0859»; thou:--as for thee, thou.

H609.def: of uncertain derivation; Asa, the name of a king and of a Levite:--Asa.

H612.def: from «0631»; a bond (especially manacles of a prisoner):--band, + prison.

H614.def: or maciph {aw-seef'}; from «0622»; gathered, i.e. (abstractly) a gathering in of crops:--ingathering.

H615.def: from «0631»; bound, i.e. a captive:--(those which are) bound, prisoner.

H617.def: the same as «0616»; prisoner; Assir, the name of two Israelites:--Assir.

H618.et: from an unused root meaning to heap together, a storehouse (only in the plural)
H618.def: from an unused root meaning to heap together; a storehouse (only in the plural):--barn, storehouse.

H619.def: of uncertain derivation; Asnah, one of the Nethinim:--Asnah.

H620.def: of foreign derivation; Osnappar, an Assyrian king:--Asnapper.

H621.def: of Egyptian derivation; Asenath, the wife of Joseph:--Asenath.

H622.def: a primitive root; to gather for any purpose; hence, to receive, take away, i.e. remove (destroy, leave behind, put up, restore, etc.):--assemble, bring, consume, destroy, felch, gather (in, together, up again), × generally, get (him), lose, put all together, receive, recover (another from leprosy), (be) rereward, × surely, take (away, into, up), × utterly, withdraw.

H623.def: from «0622»; collector; Asaph, the name of three Israelites, and of the family of the first:--Asaph.

H624.def: passive participle of «0622»; collected (only in the plural), i.e. a collection of offerings):--threshold, Asuppim.

H626.def: from «0622»; a collection of people (only adverbial):--X together.

H627.def: fem of «0624».; a collection of (learned) men (only in the plural):--assembly.

H628.def: by reduplication from «0624»; gathered up together, i.e. a promiscuous assemblage (of people):--mixt multitude.

H629.def: (Aramaic) of Persian derivation; diligently:--fast, forthwith, speed(-ily).

H630.def: of Persian derivation; Aspatha, a son of Haman:--Aspatha.

H631.def: a primitive root; to yoke or hitch; by analogy, to fasten in any sense, to join battle:--bind, fast, gird, harness, hold, keep, make ready, order, prepare, prison(-er), put in bonds, set in array, tie.

H632.def: or riccar {is-sawr'}; from «0631»; an obligation or vow (of abstinence):--binding, bond.

H633.et: corresponding to (0632) in a legal sense
H633.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «0632» in a legal sense; an interdict:--decree.

H634.def: of foreign derivation; Esar- chaddon, an Assyrian king:--Esar-haddon.

H635.def: of Persian derivation; Ester, the Jewish heroine:--Esther.

H636.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «06086»; a tree or wood:--timber, wood.

H637.def: a primitive particle; meaning accession (used as an adverb or conjunction); also or yea; adversatively though:--also, + although, and (furthermore, yet), but, even, + how much less (more, rather than), moreover, with, yea.

H639.def: from «0599»; properly, the nose or nostril; hence, the face, and occasionally a person; also (from the rapid breathing in passion) ire:--anger(-gry), + before, countenance, face, + forebearing, forehead, + (long-)suffering, nose, nostril, snout, × worthy, wrath.

H640.et: a primitive root [rather a denominative from (0646)]
H640.def: a primitive root (rather a denominative from «0646»); to gird on (the ephod):--bind, gird.

H641.def: the same as «0646» shortened; Ephod, an Israelite:--Ephod.

H642.def: feminine of «0646»; a girding on (of the ephod); hence, generally, a plating (of metal):--ephod, ornament.

H643.def: apparently of foreign derivation; a pavilion or palace-tent:--palace.

H644.def: a primitive root; to cook, especially to bake:--bake(-r, (-meats)).

H645.def: or hephowe {ay-fo'}; from «06311»; strictly a demonstrative particle, here; but used of time, now or then:--here, now, where?

H646.def: rarely oephod {ay-fode'}; probably of foreign derivation ; a girdle; specifically the ephod or high-priest's shoulder- piece; also generally, an image:--ephod.

H647.def: perhaps from «06315»; breeze; Aphiach, an Israelite:--Aphiah.

H648.et: from the same as (0651) (in the sense of weakness)
H648.def: from the same as «0651» (in the sense of weakness); unripe:--not grown up.

H649.def: dual of «0639»; two nostrils; Appajim, an Israelite:--Appaim.

H650.def: from «0622»; properly, containing, i.e. a tube; also a bed or valley of a stream; also a strong thing or a hero:--brook, channel, mighty, river, + scale, stream, strong piece.

H651.et: from an unused root meaning to set as the sun
H651.def: from an unused root meaning to set as the sun; dusky:--very dark.

H652.def: from the same as «0651»; dusk:--darkness, obscurity, privily.

H653.def: feminine of «0651»; duskiness, figuratively, misfortune; concrete, concealment:--dark, darkness, gloominess, × thick.

H655.et: from an unused root meaning to revolve
H655.def: from an unused root meaning to revolve; a turn, i.e. a season:--+ fitly.

H656.def: a primitive root; to disappear, i.e. cease:--be clean gone (at an end, brought to nought), fail.

H657.def: from «0656»; cessation, i.e. an end (especially of the earth); often used adverb, no further; also (like «06466») the ankle (in the dual), as being the extremity of the leg or foot:--ankle, but (only), end, howbeit, less than nothing, nevertheless (where), no, none (beside), not (any, -withstanding), thing of nought, save(-ing), there, uttermost part, want, without (cause).

H658.def: from «0657» and the plural of «01818»; boundary of blood-drops; Ephes-Dammim, a place in Palestine:--Ephes- dammim.

H659.et: from an unused root probably meaning to breathe
H659.def: from an unused root probably meaning to breathe; properly, a breath, i.e. nothing:--of nought.

H660.def: from «0659» (in the sense of hissing); an asp or other venomous serpent:--viper.

H662.def: a primitive root; to contain, i.e. (reflex.) abstain:--force (oneself), restrain.

H663.def: or rAphiyq {af-eek'}; from «0662» (in the sense of strength); fortress; Aphek (or Aphik), the name of three places in Palestine:--Aphek, Aphik.

H664.def: feminine of «0663»; fortress; Aphekah, a place in Palestine:--Aphekah.

H665.et: from an unused root meaning to bestrew
H665.def: from an unused root meaning to bestrew; ashes:--ashes.

H666.et: from the same as (0665) (in the sense of covering)
H666.def: from the same as «0665» (in the sense of covering); a turban:--ashes.

H667.et: from (06524) (in the sense of bursting the shell)
H667.def: from «06524» (in the sense of bursting the shell); the brood of a bird:--young (one).

H668.def: probably of Egyptian derivation; a palanquin:--chariot.

H669.def: dual of masculine form of «0672»; double fruit; Ephrajim, a son of Joseph; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory:--Ephraim, Ephraimites.

H670.et: of foreign origin (only in the plural)
H670.def: (Aramaic) of foreign origin (only in the plural); an Apherasite or inhabitant of an unknown region of Assyria:-- Apharsite.

H671.def: (Aramaic) or fApharcathkay (Aramaic) {af-ar-sath-kah'ee}; of foreign origin (only in the plural); an Apharsekite or Apharsathkite, an unknown Assyrian tribe:--Apharsachites, Apharasthchites.

H672.def: or mEphrathah {ef-raw'-thaw}; from «06509»; fruitfulness; Ephrath, another name for Bethlehem; once (Psa. 132:6) perhaps for Ephraim; also of an Israelitish woman:--Ephrath, Ephratah.

H673.def: patrial form «0672»; an Ephrathite or an Ephraimite:--Ephraimite, Ephrathite.

H674.def: (Aramaic) of Persian origin; revenue; others at the last:--revenue.

H675.def: or mEtsbon {ets-bone'}; of uncertain derivation; Etsbon, the name of two Israelites:--Ezbon.

H676.et: from the same as (06648) (in the sense of grasping)
H676.def: from the same as «06648» (in the sense of grasping); something to sieze with, i.e. a finger; by analogy, a toe:--finger, toe.

H678.et: from (0680) (in its secondary sense of separation)
H678.def: from «0680» (in its secondary sense of separation); an extremity (Isa. 41:9), also a noble:--chief man, noble.

H679.et: from (0680) (in its primary sense of uniting)
H679.def: from «0680» (in its primary sense of uniting); a joint of the hand (i.e. knuckle); also (according to some) a party-wall (Ezek. 41:8):--(arm) hole, great.

H680.def: a primitive root; properly, to join; used only as a denominative from «0681»; to separate; hence, to select, refuse, contract:--keep, reserve, straiten, take.

H681.def: from «0680» (in the sense of joining); a side; (as a preposition) near:--at, (hard) by, (from) (beside), near (unto), toward, with. See also «01018».

H682.def: from «0680»; noble; Atsel, the name of an Israelite, and of a place in Palestine:--Azal, Azel.

H683.def: from «0680» and «03050» prolonged; Jah has reserved; Atsaljah, an Israelite:--Azaliah.

H684.et: from an unused root probably meaning to be strong
H684.def: from an unused root probably meaning to be strong; strength (i.e. strong); Otsem, the name of two Israelites:--Ozem.

H685.def: a variation from «06807»; properly, a step- chain; by analogy, a bracelet:--bracelet, chain.

H686.def: a primitive root; to store up:--(lay up in) store, + (make) treasure(-r).

H688.def: from «06916»; burning, i.e. a carbuncle or other fiery gem:--carbuncle.

H689.def: probably from «0602»; slender, i.e. the ibex:--wild goat.

H690.def: probably for «0738»; lion; Ara, an Israelite:--Ara.

H692.def: from «0691»; heroic; Areli (or an Arelite, collectively), an Israelite and his descendants:--Areli, Arelites.

H693.def: a primitive root; to lurk:--(lie in) ambush(-ment), lay (lie in) wait.

H694.def: from «0693»; ambush; Arab, a place in Palestine:--Arab.

H697.def: from «07235»; a locust (from its rapid increase):-- grasshopper, locust.

H698.def: feminine of «0696» (only in the plural); ambuscades:--spoils.

H699.et: participle passive of (0693) (as if for lurking)
H699.def: feminine participle passive of «0693» (as if for lurking); a lattice; (by implication) a window, dove-cot (because of the pigeon-holes), chimney (with its apertures for smoke), sluice (with openings for water):--chimney, window.
